task.description: WF-03 Step 4: write the ISS-0780 regression test per the CODE-DESIGNER-specified shape -- one combined OPTIONS preflight test requesting x-bpm-user-id, if-match, and idempotency-key together, asserting 204 and membership of all three in access-control-allow-headers -- and prove fail-then-pass against the pre-fix commit.
acceptance_criteria: new test added to test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs matching the design's exact shape (combined preflight, membership assertion not full-string equality)
test proven to FAIL against the pre-fix commit (2ed97a50, parent of fix commit 3d1bb946)

result.summary:
Added one new test to the existing 'AC3: preflight OPTIONS request, matched origin' describe block in test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs, named 'ISS-0780 regression: x-bpm-user-id, if-match, and idempotency-key are all allowed on preflight' -- exactly the shape CODE-DESIGNER specified in step-02: a single OPTIONS /api/v1/anything preflight with access-control-request-headers: "x-bpm-user-id, if-match, idempotency-key" (fix_direction's literal exemplar first, per design), asserting conn.status == 204 and that all three header names are present in the response's access-control-allow-headers via a split/membership check (String.split(allow_headers, ", ") then `in`), not a full-string-equality pin -- keeping this test's intent legible independently of the existing exact-string assertion at line ~187-188 (already updated by ELIXIR-DEV to the corrected 5-header value). No other test in the file was modified. lib/letflow/plugs/cors.ex was not touched.

FAIL-THEN-PASS PROOF (required for a fix-to-existing-behavior regression test, WF-03 Step 4):

1) Confirmed pre-fix commit via `git log --oneline -5` on this branch: 3d1bb946 (fix, HEAD) -> 2ed97a50 (parent, pre-fix tip of main at time of branching).

2) Created a throwaway git worktree at 2ed97a50 (`git worktree add ../letflow-prefix-iss0780 2ed97a50`), confirmed its copy of cors_test.exs still had the old, uncorrected assertion (`["authorization, content-type"]`), then added ONLY the new test function (byte-for-byte identical to what was added on this branch) into that worktree's test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs -- did not touch lib/letflow/plugs/cors.ex there, so the pre-fix @allow_headers ("authorization, content-type") stayed in effect. Ran `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs` there (deps/_build borrowed via temporary Windows junctions to the main checkout's deps/_build, removed immediately after the run, before the worktree was removed via `git worktree remove --force`). Real failing output:

     1) test AC3: preflight OPTIONS request, matched origin ISS-0780 regression: x-bpm-user-id, if-match, and idempotency-key are all allowed on preflight (Letflow.Plugs.CorsTest)
        test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs:193
        Assertion with in failed
        code:  assert "x-bpm-user-id" in allowed
        left:  "x-bpm-user-id"
        right: ["authorization", "content-type"]
        stacktrace:
          test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs:209: (test)
     ...
     Result: 18/19 passed
     Failed: 1 test

   Confirms the new test genuinely exercises the bug: against pre-fix @allow_headers, the preflight succeeds (204) but the three added headers are absent, exactly matching ISS-0780's description.

3) Ran the full file on this branch (post-fix code in place): `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs` -> `Result: 19 passed` (all tests, including the new one, green).

4) Also ran `mix letflow.check.test` (the mandated fresh-recompile + ISS-0069 substring gate, not just the single file) on this branch with the real fix and new test in place. First two attempts failed on partition ecto.create/ecto.migrate with a pre-existing, unrelated local Postgres state issue (`duplicate_column "version" of relation "service_catalog"`) -- verified NOT caused by this change by reproducing it identically with `git stash` (i.e. against the already-committed fix alone, before this test was added). Root-caused to stale local partition test databases (letflow_test1..letflow_test16) left over from earlier work on this host; not a code defect and out of this task's scope to fix in lib/. Remediated by dropping all 16 stale partition databases (`MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=<n> mix ecto.drop --quiet` for n in 1..16) so ecto.create/migrate could run clean, then re-ran `mix letflow.check.test` end to end. Final real output: `mix letflow.check.test: OK -- isolated :lua_wallclock_race run also passed clean.` (exit code 0) -- full parallel suite passed, zero ISS-0069 'default values for the optional arguments' warnings, wasm_hang and lua_wallclock_race isolated subprocesses both clean.

Nothing outside test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs and handoffs/WF03-ISS0780-20260922/ was modified. lib/letflow/plugs/cors.ex is byte-for-byte as ELIXIR-DEV/REVIEWER/SECURITY-REVIEWER left it.
issues: Pre-existing, unrelated local dev-environment issue found and self-remediated (not a code defect, no fix_direction needed against lib/): stale letflow_test1..16 Postgres databases on this host held a partially-applied service_catalog migration state that made `mix letflow.check.test`'s parallel partition creation fail with duplicate_column. Reproduced independently of this change (via git stash) before touching anything, then fixed by dropping and letting the runner recreate all 16 partition databases. Flagging for TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR/ORCH awareness in case this recurs on shared CI infra -- distinct from the already-tracked ISS-0779 (a CI-only pg_isready/CREATE DATABASE race); this was local stale schema state, not a readiness race, so no new issue filed unless it recurs.
